needs_result.text: Surveyed and explored 14 heterogeneous source datasets (gene expression, gene properties, nomenclature), owning the identity-spine datasets and setting metadata boundaries for downstream modelling.
Designed a deterministic hallucination-guard architecture and fail-safe data resolution via live Ensembl/HGNC APIs with a local 19,213-gene parquet fallback and circuit breakers.

Built a tool-calling LLM agent (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude Haiku 4.5) for a multi-omics cancer research platform, with three tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
Deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda (Lambda Web Adapter) with ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least-privilege policies.

Wrote a three-tier test framework (tool-level, API/integration, live agent) of ~65 tests across 8 files, validated across the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate-limit evaluation.
Integrated the agent into a React front end with real-time gene alias enrichment.
Managed AWS account governance for the project, including root-user isolation, IAM user and group management and least-privilege policies.

Proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid-based product start-up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.

Contributed the MCP implementation to the client's production repository (TypeScript/Node.js MCP server, OpenAI query generation, Convex database), now in live day-to-day use; engagement received a 5-star commendation from senior leadership.
Built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deployed as FastAPI services in Docker.
Built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph.
Contributed to a team LoRA fine-tune of an instruction-tuned Llama model for a maths-focused task.
Built a production RAG and agentic retrieval system (Claude API, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB) served through a FastAPI REST API in Docker on GCP Cloud Run.
Integrated Twelve Data (real-time market feeds) and Plaid (bank-account linkage, transaction imports) APIs into a Flutter FinTech mobile app.
Delivered 10 reusable SwiftUI/UIKit component templates that accelerated team velocity across concurrent releases.
Designed Core Data schemas for user profiles, transaction histories and event bookings with CRUD and session-state management.
Built a JavaScript web-scraping pipeline that automated a manual collection process and surfaced market-trend signals used for pricing decisions.
Implemented offline-first data persistence (Isar) with background synchronisation in the Flutter FinTech app, keeping financial records available in low-connectivity conditions.
MCP server and stdio client combining web search with a GraphQL/PostgreSQL data layer, run against a local open-weight model (gpt-oss:20b) with CI across Python 3.9–3.11.
XGBoost churn classifier in R (tidymodels) with two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE inside the recipe and MCC evaluation.
Anomaly detection on 200:1 class-imbalanced data with Isolation Forest and ensemble classifiers, tracked in MLflow.
Full-duplex WebSocket voice agent with a rolling VAD state machine for streaming speech-to-text (faster-whisper) and barge-in.
Text-to-speech on CUDA in float16 with start-up warm-up, packaged in an nvidia/cuda Docker image.
14-node LangGraph interview pipeline with DeepFace (Facenet512) biometric verification, psycholinguistic five-dimension scoring and emergency email alerting.

needs_result.entry: CoverFit — insurance benchmarking API (Bristol × UWE AI Hackathon)
needs_result.text: Deterministic comparable-company matching over 221 profiles and 1,116 cover lines with a single LLM call for rationale, at ~£0.003 per query and under 3 s.
LSTM forecaster with cyclic date encoding and time-series cross-validated grid search, served through a TensorFlow Serving REST API.

paragraphs: Heathrow Airport Holdings seeks to turn data into operational insight, and my recent work on predictive models directly supports that goal.
I built scikit-learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid-based product start-up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.
